issues.explanation: Adrian's father was established as dead, killed in a crash five years ago, yet Adrian says he will ask his father tonight.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the line to ask a living figure, e.g. 'I'll ask my lawyer tonight' or 'I'll call my father's old attorney.'

issues.explanation: Vanessa was established as marketing director at Cross Tower (and later fired from marketing), not head of legal at Cross Capital.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the line to 'When I was marketing director at Cross Tower, I saw every contract he signed.'

issues.explanation: Ep7 said Sam's surgery was a complete success, but Ep9 says he is still waiting for surgery with the date being postponed.
issues.suggested_fix: Change Maya's line to Sam recovering from surgery or needing follow-up care, not waiting for surgery.

issues.explanation: The apartment in Ep9 is shown as Maya's, which is consistent with the Ep8 Oak Avenue building, but Ep2 established a one-room apartment on Maple Street. This is a street conflict, though it is not new in Ep9.
issues.suggested_fix: None needed for Ep9; reconcile Maple Street and Oak Avenue in earlier episodes.
